description: This file defines the WebConfig class which configures Spring MVC settings, including resource handling, view resolution, view controllers, and message source configuration.

classes.name: WebConfig
classes.description: Java configuration class for Spring MVC, implementing WebMvcConfigurer to customize MVC setup.

methods.name: addResourceHandlers
methods.description: Configures resource handling, mapping URL pattern '/resources/**' to serve static resources.

methods.name: configureDefaultServletHandling
methods.description: Enables default servlet handling for static resources.

methods.name: jspViewResolver
methods.description: Defines a bean for resolving JSP views with specified prefix and suffix.

methods.name: addViewControllers
methods.description: Maps root URL '/' to the 'index' view.

methods.name: getMessageSource
methods.description: Defines a message source bean for internationalization, reading messages from classpath with default UTF-8 encoding.
